SELECT 
  fished_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(yt) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 2 
  AND fished_date_doy >= 92 AND fished_date_doy <= 121
  AND yt > 0
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 200

SELECT DISTINCT
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as boats_scheduled
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 
  AND fish_date_doy >= 287 AND fish_date_doy <= 300
  AND cls = 'day_1_5'
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy

SELECT 
  MAX(fish_date_doy) as max_schedule_doy,
  COUNT(*) as schedule_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fish_date_doy) as days_scheduled
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_season = 2
